title: AgBench: Agentic AI Benchmarks for Personal AI Devices
abstract: arXiv:2609.38652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI systems increasingly rely on cloud-hosted large language models for planning, tool use, and iterative execution, raising concerns about API cost and data exposure. Advances in personal AI devices enable agents to execute locally, but limited resources on device may affect task success and performance. Existing benchmarks are inadequate for systematically characterizing these trade-offs across devices, workloads, and deployment architectures. We present AgBench, a benchmark suite and open artifacts for reproducible evaluation of agentic AI on personal devices. Using AgBench, we evaluate local, hybrid, and cloud execution across agentic workloads, examining task success, latency, cloud API cost, and data exposure. translated_title: AgBench：面向个人AI设备的智能体AI基准测试
translated_abstract: 智能体AI系统日益依赖云端托管的大语言模型进行规划、工具调用和迭代执行，这引发了对API成本和数据暴露风险的担忧。个人AI设备的进步使智能体能够在本地执行任务，但设备上有限的资源可能影响任务成功率和性能表现。现有的基准测试难以系统性地刻画设备、工作负载和部署架构之间的这些权衡。我们提出了AgBench，一个用于在个人设备上可复现评估智能体AI的基准测试套件及开放工件。借助AgBench，我们评估了本地、混合和云端三种执行方式在各类智能体工作负载下的表现，考察了任务成功率、延迟、云端API成本和数据暴露程度。基于超过1.6207亿个数据点的结果表明，个人AI设备可以在本地完成许多智能体任务，但纯本地执行的任务成功率通常低于云端执行，且完成时间更长。
tldr: 提出了AgBench基准测试套件，通过超过1.6亿个数据点系统评估了个人AI设备上本地、混合和云端智能体执行在任务成功率、延迟、API成本和数据隐私方面的权衡。
en_tdlr: AgBench, a benchmark suite with open artifacts for reproducible evaluation of agentic AI on personal devices, systematically quantifies the trade-offs among local, hybrid, and cloud execution across task success, latency, API cost, and data exposure.
